title: Malmstrom AFB disc wobbling on edge

tellings.quote: May not Air Force Base, home of nuclear weapons uh uh uh missiles. A border patrol officer sees a metallic disc, direct quote, wobbling on its edge, 30 feet wide, 100 feet away.

plain: At Malmstrom Air Force Base, which he describes as home to nuclear missiles, a border patrol officer is said to have seen a metallic disc "wobbling on its edge", about 30 feet wide and only 100 feet away. A guest named Marik von Rennenkampff tells Michels this in passing. He gives the officer's words as a direct quote but does not name where he read them. If it is true, an unknown craft came close to American nuclear weapons.
